(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix User. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/manage-team-members/.
active  tftypes.Bool computed
emails  nested SET computed
emails.primary  tftypes.Bool computed
emails.type  tftypes.String computed
emails.value  tftypes.String computed
groups  tftypes.Set[tftypes.String] computed
id  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: User ID. Exactly one of `id` or `user_name` must be set.
name  nested SINGLE computed
name.family_name  tftypes.String computed
name.given_name  tftypes.String computed
user_name  tftypes.String optional,computed
    description: User name (email). Exactly one of `id` or `user_name` must be set. The lookup is case-insensitive, since SSO login can normalize letter case in the backend.
